value.body: A dance teacher teaches classical, folk or contemporary dance to children or adults. Schools hire dance teachers for classes and events; academies and private classes train students for exams, competitions and stage performances. Days mix teaching, choreography and rehearsals.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BPA in dance, or long training in a dance form

items.label: Where you work
items.value: Schools, dance academies, private and online classes

items.label: B.P.A. (Performing Arts) enrolment
items.note: Covers dance, music and theatre together
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 11 (programme-wise enrolment, all modes, actual responses)

items.label: B.Dance enrolment
items.note: Students in degrees titled Bachelor of Dance; most dance degrees are listed under B.P.A. or B.A.
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 11 (programme-wise enrolment, all modes, actual responses)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Start by assisting at a dance academy, teaching at a school or running your own classes. Government school posts have their own eligibility rules and recruitment exams.

value.title: At a glance
items: Many teachers also perform or run their own academy.
College teaching usually needs a master's plus UGC-NET or a PhD.
Income from private classes depends on location and student numbers.

value.title: B.P.A. (Performing Arts) enrolment
value.note: Includes music and theatre as well as dance; counts only institutions that responded to AISHE
value.source: AISHE 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24, Table 11 (programme-wise enrolment, actual responses)
